rows.note: Use 筆 as the all-purpose word for a writing pen.

example.english: This pen has run out of ink.
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 bat1 mou5 saai3 mak6 laa3

rows.note: Use 牛欄 specifically for a cattle pen.

example.english: The farmer opened the cattle pen in the morning so the cows could go out to graze.
example.traditional: 農夫朝早就開牛欄畀啲牛出去食草。
example.jyutping: nung4 fu1 ziu1 zou2 zau6 hoi1 ngau4 laan4 bei2 di1 ngau4 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 cou2

rows.note: Use 羊欄 specifically for a sheep pen.

example.english: Remember to shut the sheep pen properly at night, or the sheep will get lost.
example.traditional: 夜晚要記得閂好羊欄，唔係啲羊會走失。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 jiu3 gei3 dak1 saan1 hou2 joeng4 laan4 m4 hai6 di1 joeng4 wui5 zau2 sat1
